inputs.original_text: This looks less like a response to one arrest and more like an effort to turn an individual case into a pretext for dismantling New York City’s sanctuary protections. When institutions use fear to cast suspicion on whole immigrant communities, people already facing discrimination pay the price. Public safety means fair, accountable policies—not treating immigration status as proof of danger or using one case to justify harsher enforcement.
inputs.modified_text: This is about more than one arrest: it risks using an individual case to weaken New York City’s sanctuary protections and expand suspicion toward immigrant communities. That kind of fear-driven politics puts people already facing discrimination at greater risk. Public safety requires fair, accountable policies—not treating immigration status as evidence of danger or using one case to excuse harsher enforcement.
